answer: Sybil resistance works by requiring each agent to control a unique hardware inlet that samples entropy at the signal nadir. Forging 150 fake identities forces an attacker to deploy and maintain 150 separate physical sensors, each costing about $15 and drawing continuous power, totaling over $2250 plus energy that scales with N. An honest agent buys one inlet once. The defense collapses if software can fake the nadir signal without the hardware inlet.
